description: Deduped precedent-deal list for valuation-multiple research. 43 source rows deduped to 35 unique deals. 'as_given' preserves the original spellings from the source list; 'search_hints' carries canonical names / suspected typo fixes for the researcher to verify via web search, not to assume.

deals.search_hints: Likely Coda Markets (broker-dealer / order routing). Appeared 3x in source list.
Porch Group (NASDAQ: PRCH) acquisition of Floify (mortgage point-of-sale software), announced 2021.
Constant Contact (backed by Clearlake Capital and Siris) acquisition of SharpSpring (NASDAQ: SHSP), announced 2021. Public-target deal, so financials should be on file.
Stewart Information Services (NYSE: STC) acquisition of CloudVirga (digital mortgage POS). 'CloudVerga' in the source list is a typo. Appeared 2x in source list.
Inflexion Private Equity and Infront (likely Infront ASA, Nordic financial market data / terminal provider). Verify the entity and transaction via search.
GLAS = Global Loan Agency Services (loan agency / bond trustee services).
Likely Automated Financial Systems, Inc. (AFS, commercial lending software). Verify entity.
Centerbridge Partners take-private of MeridianLink (NYSE: MLNK), announced 2025. Public-target deal - proxy/merger docs should allow multiple calculation. Appeared 2x in source list.
Solifi (secured-finance / equipment-finance software, formerly IDS). Appeared 2x in source list.
Axway acquisition of Sopra Banking Software (SBS) from Sopra Steria, announced 2024. French listed parties - transaction terms were published.
Thomas H. Lee Partners investment in Odessa Technologies (asset finance / leasing software), 2021. Appeared 2x in source list.

Veritas Capital acquisition of NCR Voyix's digital banking business (renamed Candescent), announced 2024 (~$2.45B + contingent). Seller was public - segment financials disclosed. Appeared 3x in source list.
Rocket Companies all-stock acquisition of Mr. Cooper Group (NASDAQ: COOP), announced 2025 (~$9.4B). Both public - multiples calculable from filings.
Inhabit (aka Inhabit IQ, property-management software). Verify Blackstone/Goldman investment, ~2021.

'Atlus' in the source list is likely Altus Group (TSX: AIF). Verify the transaction between Altus Group and SitusAMC (real estate valuation/mortgage services) including direction - one party may have acquired a business unit of the other.
CoStar acquisition of OnTheMarket plc (UK property portal, AIM-listed), announced 2023 (~GBP 99M). Public target - Rule 2.7 announcement has terms.
Constellation Software (Perseus) acquisition of Optimal Blue from Black Knight, 2024 (~$700M) - a divestiture required by the ICE / Black Knight merger. Terms published.

as_given: National Financial / Black Knight Title Point
deals.search_hints: 'National Financial' in the source list is likely Fidelity National Financial (FNF). FNF acquired TitlePoint (title search software) from Black Knight, announced late 2022 / closed 2023 (~$225M).
Voxtur Analytics (TSXV: VXTR) acquisition of Blue Water Financial Technologies, 2021. Canadian listed acquirer - deal terms in press release / filings.
Stewart Information Services acquisition of Informative Research (credit and verification services), 2021.
Blend Labs acquisition of Title365 from Mr. Cooper, 2021 (~$422M for 90.1%). Both parties public / soon-to-be-public - financials disclosed in Blend's S-1 and filings.
Ideanomics (NASDAQ: IDEX) acquisition of Timios Holdings (title and escrow), announced January 2021. Acquirer public - 8-K should have terms.
STG = Symphony Technology Group. Alveo (financial data management, formerly Asset Control). Verify transaction and date.
Gemspring Capital acquisition of GoldenSource (EDM / reference data management), 2022.
MeridianLink (NYSE: MLNK) acquisition of OpenClose (mortgage LOS/POS), 2022 (~$65M). Acquirer public - 8-K / press release has terms.
'Walker Dunlap' is a typo for Walker & Dunlop (NYSE: WD). Acquired GeoPhy (CRE data / AVM), announced 2022 ($85M + earnout).
Nasdaq acquisition of Adenza (Calypso + AxiomSL) from Thoma Bravo, announced June 2023 ($10.5B). Investor presentation published revenue/ARR multiples explicitly.
Confidential / code-named deal - no public identity to research.
Likely Apax Partners' acquisition of Finastra's Treasury & Capital Markets (TCM) division, announced 2025 - verify whether the row means the TCM carve-out or another Apax/Finastra transaction.
Source row has the order swapped: SoFi Technologies (NASDAQ: SOFI) acquired Technisys (core banking) in an all-stock deal announced February 2022 (~$1.1B). Acquirer public - terms disclosed.
Fiserv acquisition of the remainder of Finxact (cloud core banking), announced 2022 (~$650M for remaining ownership). Acquirer public.
nCino (NASDAQ: NCNO) acquisition of SimpleNexus (mortgage POS), announced November 2021 (~$1.2B stock+cash). Acquirer public - investor deck disclosed target revenue.
Motive Partners growth investment in Backbase (digital banking platform), 2024 (EUR 120M at ~EUR 2.5B valuation - verify). Minority/growth deal rather than full M&A.
nCino acquisition of FullCircl (UK client lifecycle intelligence / onboarding), announced 2024 (~$135M). Acquirer public - 8-K / press release has terms.
CSI = Computer Services, Inc. (core banking, Centerbridge/Bridgeport-owned). Apiture = digital banking platform. Verify the transaction and date via search.
